name: Apple Design
descZh: Apple 液态玻璃设计规范：冷灰白地 + 统一面板 + 发丝分割线，玻璃只用于导航/浮层，正文黑白灰 + 一个蓝色强调。
descEn: The macOS Liquid Glass aesthetic: cool grey-white ground, unified panels with hairline dividers, glass only on nav/overlays, grayscale body with a single blue accent.

name: Frontend Design
descZh: Anthropic 官方插件：写码前强制确定美学方向，规避 AI 默认套路（Inter 字体 + 紫色渐变），要求统一色彩系统。
descEn: Anthropic's official plugin: forces an aesthetic direction before coding, avoiding AI clichés (Inter font + purple gradients) and enforcing a unified color system.

name: UI/UX Pro Max
descZh: 62k★ 社区热门：240+ 样式、127 组字体搭配、99 条 UX 准则，自动匹配产品类型。
descEn: Popular community skill (62k★): 240+ styles, 127 font pairings, 99 UX guidelines, auto-matched to product type.

name: Theme Factory
descZh: 官方 skills 集合中的主题应用：把品牌色/设计系统一键应用为 CSS 变量。
descEn: Theme application from the official skills set: turns brand colors / design systems into CSS variables.

name: Canvas Design
descZh: 官方 skills：布局型视觉设计，导出 PNG / PDF。
descEn: Official skill: layout-focused visual design with PNG / PDF export.

name: Power Design
descZh: 社区 skill：20 条数字化设计规则（可用性 / WCAG / 可读性阈值），自动应用到页面。
descEn: Community skill: 20 digital-design rules (usability, WCAG, readability thresholds) auto-applied to pages.

name: Web Artifacts Builder
descZh: 官方 skills：用 React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui 构建多文件项目，再打包成单个 HTML。
descEn: Official skill: build multi-file projects with React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui, then bundle into a single HTML.

name: Webapp Testing
descZh: 官方 skills：网页自动化测试，点选 / 截图 / 校验渲染结果。
descEn: Official skill: automated web testing — click, screenshot and validate rendered results.

name: Claude API
descZh: Claude API / Anthropic SDK 参考：模型 ID、定价、参数、流式、工具调用、缓存。
descEn: Claude API / Anthropic SDK reference: model IDs, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, caching.

name: Code Review
descZh: 代码审查技能：审查 PR 或当前改动，给出可执行的安全 / 正确性 / 性能发现。
descEn: Code-review skill: reviews PRs or the working diff with actionable security, correctness and performance findings.

name: Video Production Skill
descZh: AI Agent 自动产出口播教学视频：脚本 → 生图 → TTS → Whisper 回验 → FFmpeg 合成 → 字幕。
descEn: An AI agent skill that auto-produces talking-head videos: script → image gen → TTS → Whisper back-check → FFmpeg → captions.

name: Image Generation
descZh: 统一的图片生成技能（FHL OpenAI 兼容接口），用于配图、图标、插画、海报。
descEn: A unified image-generation skill (FHL OpenAI-compatible API) for illustrations, icons, art and posters.

name: UI Slicing
descZh: UI 图批量切图：从设计稿提取图标 / 按钮 / 插画，输出像素版 + 高清透明底素材。
descEn: Batch UI slicing: extract icons, buttons and illustrations from a design, outputting pixel crops plus clean transparent PNGs.

name: Data Visualization
descZh: 任何图表 / 仪表盘 / 数据可视化之前的必读规范：统一配色、明暗主题、可访问性。
descEn: Required reading before any chart, dashboard or visualization: unified palette, light/dark themes, accessibility.

name: Update Config
descZh: 配置 Claude Code 环境：hooks、权限、环境变量、settings.json 的自动化调整。
descEn: Configure the Claude Code harness: hooks, permissions, env vars and settings.json automation.

name: Loop
descZh: 定时循环执行某个 prompt / 命令，用于轮询状态、定时任务、重复检查。
descEn: Run a prompt or command on a recurring interval — polling, scheduled jobs, repeated checks.

name: Keybindings Help
descZh: 定制 Claude Code 键盘快捷键、绑定键位、修改 keybindings.json。
descEn: Customize Claude Code keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys and edit keybindings.json.

name: Simplify
descZh: 审查改动并应用复用 / 简化 / 效率优化，专注代码质量而非找 bug。
descEn: Reviews changes and applies reuse, simplification and efficiency cleanups — quality-focused, not bug-hunting.

name: Fewer Permission Prompts
descZh: 扫描常用只读命令，写入 allowlist 以减少权限弹窗，让长任务更流畅。
descEn: Scans common read-only commands into an allowlist to reduce permission prompts for smoother long tasks.

name: Context7 MCP
descZh: MCP 服务器：实时拉取任意库的最新文档，减少 AI 对 API 的幻觉。
descEn: An MCP server that pulls live, up-to-date docs for any library, reducing API hallucination.

name: Brand Guidelines
descZh: 官方 skills：把品牌色、字体、语气规范固化为可复用的设计准则。
descEn: Official skill: codifies brand colors, type and tone into reusable design guidelines.

name: Design System Architect
descZh: 用单个品牌色生成整套 OKLCH 语义化明暗主题 token，输出 Tailwind v4 主题配置。
descEn: Derives a full OKLCH semantic light/dark token set from a single brand hue, outputting Tailwind v4 theme config.

name: Security Review
descZh: 对当前分支的改动做安全审查：注入、敏感信息、依赖漏洞与不安全的默认值。
descEn: Security review of the working tree: injection, leaked secrets, vulnerable deps and unsafe defaults.

name: Review
descZh: 审查 GitHub PR 或当前工作区 diff，输出正确性 / 安全 / 性能的分级发现。
descEn: Reviews a GitHub PR or the working diff with ranked correctness, security and performance findings.

name: Init
descZh: 为项目生成 CLAUDE.md 代码库文档，让后续 AI 会话快速理解项目约定。
descEn: Generates a CLAUDE.md codebase doc so future AI sessions pick up project conventions quickly.

name: Run
descZh: 启动并驱动当前项目，在真实运行环境中验证改动（浏览器 / 服务器 / CLI）。
descEn: Launches and drives the current project to verify changes in a real running environment.

name: Web Scraping MCP
descZh: 抓取网页结构化数据、处理登录与反爬，接入 Claude Code 的 MCP 工具。
descEn: Scrapes structured web data, handling auth and anti-bot, exposed as Claude Code MCP tools.

name: Localization
descZh: 把项目文案批量翻译成多语言并保持占位符与格式一致，输出语言包。
descEn: Batch-translates project copy into multiple languages while preserving placeholders and format, outputting locale packs.

name: Playwright MCP
descZh: Microsoft 官方浏览器自动化：点选、截图、读渲染后 DOM、测 Core Web Vitals。
descEn: Microsoft's official browser automation: click, screenshot, read rendered DOM and measure Core Web Vitals.

name: Figma MCP
descZh: 读取 Figma 设计稿的结构化变量（颜色/间距/字体）直接转成代码。
descEn: Reads structured Figma design variables (colors, spacing, fonts) and turns them straight into code.

name: Chrome DevTools MCP
descZh: 浏览器控制台、网络与性能调试，配 Playwright 做「开发→验证→调试」闭环。
descEn: Browser console, network and performance debugging — pairs with Playwright for a develop-verify-debug loop.

name: v0 Platform MCP
descZh: Vercel v0 多屏 UI 原型工作流：描述需求，生成多屏界面与代码。
descEn: Vercel v0 multi-screen UI prototyping: describe a need and get multi-screen interfaces and code.

name: SQLite MCP
descZh: 让 Claude 直接查询与操作 SQLite 数据库，做数据探索与报表。
descEn: Lets Claude query and operate a SQLite database directly for data exploration and reports.

name: Document Skills (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX)
descZh: 官方文档技能集：解析 PDF、Word、Excel、PPT，提取文字、表格与结构。
descEn: Official document skills: parse PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, extracting text, tables and structure.

name: Image Understanding
descZh: 看图分析：OCR 文字、识别物体、读取图表与截图信息。
descEn: Vision analysis: OCR text, recognize objects, and read charts and screenshots.

name: Voice Cloning
descZh: 用几秒到几分钟样本克隆声音做配音（ElevenLabs / MiniMax / RVC）。
descEn: Clone a voice from seconds to minutes of samples for dubbing (ElevenLabs / MiniMax / RVC).

name: Subtitle Generation
descZh: Whisper 转录生成词级时间戳字幕，对齐导出 SRT / 烧录。
descEn: Whisper transcription with word-level timestamps, aligned into SRT / burned-in captions.

name: Thumbnail Maker
descZh: 批量生成视频/社媒封面：选图、加标题字、统一模板风格。
descEn: Batch-generate video/social covers: pick imagery, add headline text, keep a consistent template.

name: Brainstorm
descZh: 多角度头脑风暴：发散选项、分类收敛、再按标准打分，帮你做「想不到」的补充。
descEn: Structured brainstorming: diverge options, cluster them, then score against criteria to surface what you'd miss.

name: Decision Maker
descZh: 把选择变成可比较的决策矩阵：标准权重打分，给出推荐与理由。
descEn: Turns a choice into a comparable decision matrix: weighted scoring across criteria, with a recommendation and reasoning.

name: Email Drafting
descZh: 按语气（正式/亲切/简短）起草与改写邮件，处理多收件人与跟进度。
descEn: Draft and rewrite emails by tone (formal / friendly / brief), handling multiple recipients and follow-up threads.

name: Content Summarizer
descZh: 长文/视频/音频一键提炼要点，输出结构化摘要与行动项。
descEn: One-click key-point extraction from long text, video or audio into a structured summary plus action items.

name: Skill Factory
descZh: 把反复做的事封装成自己的 skill：按规范生成 SKILL.md 与参考文件。
descEn: Package what you do repeatedly into your own skill: generate SKILL.md and reference files to spec.

name: GitHub MCP
descZh: 直接操作 GitHub：建 issue、开 PR、审代码、查仓库状态。
descEn: Operate GitHub directly: create issues, open PRs, review code and inspect repo state.

name: Screenshot MCP
descZh: 网页/桌面截图并读取截图内容，用于视觉验证与文档配图。
descEn: Capture web/desktop screenshots and read them back — for visual verification and docs.

name: Web Research
descZh: 多来源深度网络研究：检索、交叉验证、整理成带引用的报告。
descEn: Multi-source deep web research: search, cross-verify and assemble a cited report.

name: Notion MCP
descZh: 读写 Notion 页面与数据库：记笔记、建知识库、查 Wiki。
descEn: Read and write Notion pages and databases: note-taking, knowledge bases and wiki lookups.

name: Calendar MCP
descZh: 查询与创建日历事件，让 AI 帮你排日程、查空闲、建提醒。
descEn: Query and create calendar events — let the AI schedule, find free time and set reminders.

name: Mind Map
descZh: 把要点整理成思维导图/大纲结构，导出 Markdown 或 Mermaid。
descEn: Organize points into a mind map / outline structure, exportable as Markdown or Mermaid.

name: Speech-to-Text
descZh: 语音/音频转文字：会议、访谈、口述转写并标注时间戳。
descEn: Turn speech and audio into text: meetings, interviews and dictation with timestamps.

name: Superpowers
descZh: 社区第一的 Claude Code 技能框架：plan-first + TDD + 子代理开发方法论，26 万+ star。
descEn: The #1 community Claude Code skill framework: plan-first + TDD + subagent development, 260k+ stars.

name: Everything Claude Code (ECC)
descZh: Agent 工具箱：罗列 100+ 技能/记忆/安全工具，Claude Code 配置的入口级仓库。
descEn: An agent harness cataloging 100+ skills, memory and security tools — the entry point for Claude Code config.

name: Matt Pocock Skills
descZh: 真工程场景的实战 skills（测试、重构、调试等），20 万+ star，实用派代表。
descEn: Production-grade engineering skills (testing, refactoring, debugging), 200k+ stars — the pragmatic pick.

name: Karpathy Skills
descZh: 基于 Karpathy 观察提炼的 Claude Code 行为规则（单文件），史上 star 最多的单文件仓库之一。
descEn: Claude Code behavior rules distilled from Karpathy's observations (single file) — among the most-starred single-file repos.

name: GStack
descZh: YC 总裁 Garry Tan 的完整 Claude Code 配置（23 工具 + skills），可直接照抄的工程模板。
descEn: YC president Garry Tan's complete Claude Code config (23 tools + skills) — a copy-ready engineering template.

name: Claude Mem
descZh: Claude Code 跨会话持久记忆：压缩历史会话可检索，8.9 万+ star 的记忆事实标准。
descEn: Cross-session persistent memory for Claude Code: compresses past sessions into searchable memory, 89k+ stars.

name: Awesome MCP Servers
descZh: 最大的 MCP 服务器精选目录，9 万+ star，找工具与能力按图索骥。
descEn: The largest curated MCP server directory, 91k+ stars — browse tools and capabilities by category.

name: Deep Research
descZh: 自主深研 Agent：问题分解 → 并行检索 → 交叉验证 → 带引文成稿，深研赛道成熟度第一。
descEn: Autonomous deep-research agent: decompose → parallel search → cross-verify → cited report. The most mature deep-research tool.

name: Filesystem MCP
descZh: 本地文件系统读写：查看目录、读写文件、移动/搜索文件，让 Claude 直接操作你的项目文件。

descEn: Fetch web pages and convert them to text/Markdown so Claude can read online docs and pages.

name: Sequential Thinking MCP

name: Memory MCP
descZh: 基于知识图谱的长期记忆，跨会话记住用户偏好与项目事实。

name: Git MCP

descEn: Operates Git directly: view status/diff/log, create branches, commit code, fitting into coding workflows.

name: PostgreSQL MCP

name: Redis MCP

name: Docker MCP

name: Kubernetes MCP

name: Terraform MCP

name: PubMed MCP

descEn: Generate an SEO writing brief with title, outline, H-structure, and internal/external link suggestions aligned to search intent.

name: 博客大纲
descZh: 快速搭出有信息层级和逻辑钩子的博客大纲，再逐节扩写，避免写到一半跑题。
descEn: Rapidly build a blog outline with clear information hierarchy and logical hooks, then expand section by section.

name: 开头钩子
descZh: 批量生成悬念、反常识、痛点等不同风格的开头钩子，多选一提高完读率。
descEn: Batch-generate opening hooks in suspense, counterintuitive, and pain-point styles to lift completion rates.

name: P.A.S. 文案框架
descZh: 用「问题-激化-方案」三段框架写说服型文案，直接套用到落地页、广告和销售信。
descEn: Write persuasive copy with the Problem-Agitate-Solve framework, ready for landing pages, ads, and sales letters.

name: 广告文案
descZh: 按受众和投放渠道批量生成广告文案变体，含主标题、副标题与行动号召，方便 A/B 测试。
descEn: Generate ad copy variants for a target audience and channel, with headlines, subheads, and CTAs for A/B testing.

name: 邮件序列
descZh: 设计欢迎、培育、挽回三类邮件序列，按节奏推进打开与转化，每封只做一件事。
descEn: Design welcome, nurture, and win-back email sequences that move opens and conversions forward with deliberate pacing.

name: 播客节目笔记
descZh: 从音频转写稿提炼节目笔记：核心要点、时间戳和行动项，可直接发布。
descEn: Distill show notes from audio transcripts: key takeaways, timestamps, and action items, ready to publish.

name: YouTube 脚本
descZh: 写带开头钩子、段落节奏和 CTA 的口播脚本，按字数控制成片时长。
descEn: Write voiceover scripts with opening hooks, segment pacing, and CTAs, with word count to control runtime.

name: 社媒文案
descZh: 一套内容改写成抖音、小红书、微博等平台适配文案，带话题标签和互动引导。
descEn: Adapt one piece of content into platform-fit captions for Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Weibo, and more, with hashtags and engagement prompts.

name: 品牌语气
descZh: 把品牌调性固化为语气规范，让所有 AI 产出的文案保持同一种声音。
descEn: Turn brand personality into a tone-of-voice guideline so every piece of AI-generated copy sounds like one brand.

name: 剧本对白
descZh: 写短视频、动画、微短剧的分场对白，含动作与情绪提示，可直接进分镜。
descEn: Write scene-by-scene dialogue for short videos, animation, and micro-dramas, with action and emotion cues for storyboards.

name: 落地页生成
descZh: 从产品卖点一键产出结构化落地页：Hero/卖点/证据/FAQ/CTA，标题与按钮文案遵循 AIDA 转化逻辑。
descEn: Generate a structured landing page from product bullets: Hero/benefits/proof/FAQ/CTA, with copy following AIDA conversion logic.

name: 线框图
descZh: 内容优先：先输出语义化的线框（标题/正文/图片/按钮占位），确认信息架构后再谈视觉，避免一上来堆视觉。
descEn: Content-first: output semantic wireframes (headings/body/media/button placeholders) to lock the IA before any visual polish.

name: 图标设计
descZh: 在统一网格上生成 SVG 图标集：一致的线宽、圆角、端点与描边对齐，保证整套图标风格统一。
descEn: Produce a consistent SVG icon set on a shared grid: uniform stroke width, corner radius, caps and stroke alignment.

name: 字体排版
descZh: 输出字号阶梯（12/14/16/20/24/32…）、字重、行高与负字距规范，中文字号行高按方块字单独适配。
descEn: Ship a type scale (12/14/16/20/24/32…), weight, line-height and negative-tracking spec, tuned separately for CJK text.

name: 配色方案
descZh: 从品牌色推导完整语义配色：强调/中性/语义色（成功·警告·错误）加深浅两套主题，并用工具校验 WCAG 对比度。
descEn: Derive a full semantic palette from a brand color: accents/neutrals/status (success, warning, danger) plus light/dark, contrast-checked for WCAG.

name: 组件库规范
descZh: 梳理按钮/卡片/表单等组件的状态（hover/focus/disabled/loading）与尺寸（sm/md/lg），输出统一的组件规范与 tokens。
descEn: Define states (hover/focus/disabled/loading) and sizes (sm/md/lg) for buttons, cards and forms, outputting a unified component spec with tokens.

name: 微交互
descZh: 为按钮/卡片/浮层设计克制的 hover 与过渡动效：统一时长与缓动（120ms 触感 + 240ms 层动效），并尊重 reduced-motion。
descEn: Design restrained hover and transition motion for buttons/cards/overlays: consistent duration and easing (120ms tactile, 240ms layer), honoring reduced-motion.

name: 无障碍审查
descZh: 按 WCAG 2.2 审查界面：对比度、可见焦点环、aria/语义标签与键盘可达性，输出按严重度排序的修复清单。
descEn: Audit UI against WCAG 2.2: contrast, visible focus, aria/semantic labels and keyboard reachability, with a severity-ranked fix list.

name: 暗色模式设计
descZh: 把浅色主题正确转为暗色：不用纯黑地面、表面降饱和、避免纯白文字，暗色下的对比度与发光感重新调校。
descEn: Convert a light theme to dark correctly: no pure-black ground, desaturated surfaces, no pure-white text, with re-tuned contrast and glow.

name: 移动端 UI
descZh: 窄屏重排：导航折叠为抽屉/底部栏、点击区不小于 44px、按拇指热区优化布局，兼顾触控与单手操作。
descEn: Rework UI for narrow screens: fold nav into drawers/bottom bars, keep touch targets ≥44px, and optimize thumb zones for one-handed use.

name: 设计评审
descZh: 按清单评审界面：层级、间距比例、一致性、可用性与细节像素，每条给出可执行修改而非泛泛评价。
descEn: Review UI against a checklist: hierarchy, spacing rhythm, consistency, usability and pixel detail, with an actionable fix per finding.

name: 玻璃拟态
descZh: 正确使用毛玻璃：只在层叠处用（导航/浮层/侧栏），背景色彩饱和 + backdrop-blur，前景配高对比文本避免糊成一片。
descEn: Use glass correctly: only where layers overlap (nav/overlays/sidebars), saturated colorful backdrop with backdrop-blur, and high-contrast foreground to avoid a muddy blur.
